summary.text: Dan Kiger is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 90, and is on the ballot in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia reports that Gov. Josh Stein appointed him on June 24, 2026, to replace Sarah Stevens, and lists his career experience as working as a police officer.
